newsitem.title: UK: Lasmo rises as oil price extends gains.
newsitem.headline: Lasmo rises as oil price extends gains.

text.p: Shares in oil and exploration company Lasmo Plc and other oil stocks climbed on Tuesday as crude oil prices continued to rise, dealers said.
Lasmo shares rose 8-1/2p, or 3.6 per cent, to 243p by 0945 GMT after Brent dated crude gained in London for the fifth consecutive day.
Brent dated crude was trading at $19.51 per barrel in London, up from $17.70 on May 2.

Elsewhere in the oil sector, shares in British Petroleum Plc gained 6-1/2p to 746p, in spite of the company saying its Foinhaven oil field west of the Shetland Islands was unlikely to start producing before late August after leaks were found during final testing.
Dealers said a strong performance by BP ADRs in New York overnight, up $3-3/4 to $146-1/2, underpinnned the shares.
Similarly, shares in Shell Transport and Trading Co Plc extended recent gains as they advanced 13p to 11.54-1/2 stg, an all-time high, after Royal Dutch ADRS gained $3 to $112-5/8.
Enterprise Oil Plc was up 7p at 653.
